description: This file defines a HTTP handler for UI-related DID and VC operations, including DID resolution, VC retrieval, verification, export, and related functionalities. It utilizes the Gin framework and interacts with internal services and storage.

classes.name: DIDHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests related to DID and VC operations for the UI.

methods.name: NewDIDHandler
methods.description: Constructor for DIDHandler instances, initializing with storage and service dependencies.

methods.name: GetNodeDIDHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve DID info for a specific node.

methods.name: GetNodeVCStatusHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve VC status info for a specific node.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCStatusHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve VC info about a specific execution.

methods.name: GetExecutionVCHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests for a specific execution's VC data.

methods.name: GetWorkflowVCStatusBatchHandler
methods.description: Handles POST requests returning VC status summaries for multiple workflows.

methods.name: GetWorkflowVCChainHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests for workflow VC chain information.

methods.name: DownloadVCHandler
methods.description: Handles requests to download a specific VC document.

methods.name: VerifyVCHandler
methods.description: Handles POST requests to verify a VC.

methods.name: VerifyExecutionVCComprehensiveHandler
methods.description: Handles POST requests for comprehensive verification of an execution's VC.

methods.name: VerifyWorkflowVCComprehensiveHandler
methods.description: Handles POST requests for comprehensive verification of a workflow's VC.

methods.name: ExportVCsHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests to export VCs with optional filters.

methods.name: GetDIDSystemStatusHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests for DID system status.

methods.name: GetDIDResolutionBundleHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests for DID resolution bundle information.

methods.name: DownloadDIDResolutionBundleHandler
methods.description: Handles requests to download a DID resolution bundle.
